name: Old maps and charts
description: Decorative maps, city plans, bird's-eye views and celestial charts made before 1900, for a screen that rewards a closer look.

works.alt_text: A pictorial map of the Tōkaidō road crowded with tiny towns, rivers and bays in green and blue, with Mount Fuji and a red sun at the top left.
A hand-coloured allegorical map of a Kingdom of Love, with pastel regions, rivers, little mountains and German place names.
A hand-coloured bird's-eye map of Alexandria, its walled city on a green coast with sailing ships on a blue sea.
A coloured street map of lower Manhattan with ward boundaries, a street index at the side and small pictures of buildings along the top.
A Japanese world map of two hemispheres on a dark blue ground, with continents in red, yellow and green under a red title panel.
An engraved map of Greece and the Aegean Sea crowded with islands and place names, with a decorative cartouche at the lower left.
An engraved plan of ancient Rome showing its monuments, walls and the winding Tiber, with Latin text panels.
A pale drawn map of the hills and walls of ancient Rome beside a classical monument where a man sits reading.
An engraved plan of eighteenth-century Rome on joined sheets, with a decorative title cartouche, a compass rose and long index columns.
A plan of ancient Rome drawn as fragments of a broken marble map, with the word ROMA in large letters across the top.
A bird's-eye engraving of Venice floating in its lagoon, with mountains beyond, coats of arms at the top and Latin verses below.
A pale map of early New York at the tip of Manhattan, with streets, wharves, a large title and coats of arms.
A black and white bird's-eye view of New York and Brooklyn on either side of the East River, crowded with ships.
An engraved view of the Inn Valley with steep alpine peaks above fields and villages, and two smaller valley scenes below.
A coloured bird's-eye view of the Brooklyn Bridge lit by fireworks over a night harbour full of sailing boats and steamers.
A facsimile of an early world map on a heart-shaped projection, ringed by puffing wind heads, printed on cream paper.
A facsimile of Mercator's map of the Arctic, a round map of the North Pole in a decorative square frame with corner roundels.
A Japanese print of an ornate celestial globe on a red stand, below a black title panel with large characters and red seals.
A woodcut bird's-eye view of part of Venice from high above, with the lagoon, distant mountains and wind heads in the clouds.
A woodcut bird's-eye view of the whole of Venice set in its lagoon, surrounded by ships, clouds and small islands.
A section of an engraved street plan of Rome showing a bend of the Tiber, city blocks and gardens in fine black lines.
A section of an engraved street plan of central Rome, densely packed with dark city blocks between pale streets and squares.
A coloured view looking down on a busy London livestock market, with pens of sheep and cattle in a square ringed by houses.
An etched view of the walled town of Augsburg across a river, with a tall church tower rising above the roofs.
